While Steyer’s spending on his own races has accomplished nothing, his spending on the 2018 Florida gubernatorial primary seems like it may have been extremely consequential (in a bad way).


David Weigel (@daveweigel)

If Steyer doesn’t advance to the general, is he the least successful big spender in history?

Bloomberg spent more to not become president, but he won three NYC elections. Steyer would have spent more than half a billion dollars (2020/26) for nothing.

And then in Rowhouse DC we have these mandatory rinky dink front yards nobody uses instead of bigger back yards for kids to play in … why?

Like why does the new building here need to be set back five feet further than every historic building on the block? Who does this help? 

It’s thousands of square feet of usable space gone across an 11 story building for no reason.

I think building setback rules may be the single most perverse idea we’ve adopted in this country — high compliance costs and no benefit whatsoever. 

You go to any normal old neighborhood and the buildings are flush with the sidewalk and it’s fine.
